headline: Dubai engineering firm Kent projects record $1.5 billion revenue driven by Iraq expansion
summary: Dubai-headquartered engineering company Kent expects annual revenue to reach $1.5 billion, citing strong expansion in Iraq despite regional war disruptions.
why: Kent delivers major engineering and procurement projects for global energy and petrochemical infrastructure.

impacts.why: Project growth in Middle Eastern oil and gas sectors drives revenue toward record levels.
